notes.title: Zombie Watch - Release Date
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31785142/25842c47f442291448e9674a1d603d6266faba41.png

Hello everyone,

we are pleased to announce that the official release of Zombie Watch is only a short week away, we are officially releasing our game on the 17th of September here on Steam and also on Xbox. This has been a fun experience and we hope you will enjoy surviving the harsh post-apocalyptic world of Zombie Watch.

What is new:
- 2 new maps, so now you can explore the mainland, forest, town, swamp, mountain, and island.
- New zombies,
- Bandit NPC,
- Events,
- Some new items and weapons,
- General improvements and bug fixes.

Thank you for supporting us.

notes.title: Major Update - 0.7
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31785142/a0bd7b88ea2b40322388dcd600c0fcc8f8581711.jpg

We have some exciting news and we honestly hope you guys will share our enthusiasm. We took our time to look into the feedback from our players and we came to the conclusion that we needed to create a whole new experience of Zombie Watch and bring it closer to our mobile version. We are not talking just about the design or maps, we actually went back to the basics and changed the way of doing a lot of things in Zombie Watch. It was something we were thinking about for a while because the game did not meet our vision once had. Somewhere along the line of creating our game, we lost our silver lining and we could not let that continue. It may seem like we were taking a long pause because a lot of time has passed since our last update, but the reality is we were once more developing Zombie Watch from the beginning. This time we are extremely content with the way things are going. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31785142/02a56783597b712a089c1567e252cfad69705088.png

So what has changed? Well, it is easier to list the things that weren't changed - Zombie Watch is still a top-down, third-person, survival open-world game. You still gather, scavenge, defend, fight zombies, build and craft all while having basic human needs like water, food, health. Then things get more exciting - we created a whole new world of Zombie Watch. Now there are multiple smaller maps with different biomes, where you can build your base on the main map but also explore other biomes, like forests, a swamp, and a mountain area. We will not stop there, a few other maps are already in development, like a huge town for example. On all of these maps, there are numerous special places with hidden treasure boxes and smaller towns with loot and special flora. You get your own survivors base of which you are in charge but let's not get ahead of ourselves - a lot of new features are still in development as this continues to be an early access game. We are working hard to keep the progress going since we will also be releasing Zombie Watch in its new image on XBOX in a year or two.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31785142/df760af0783fea1dee0d979618fdbd827383ac78.png

To recap whats new:
- New maps
- New character with movement and attacks
- New zombie models and animations
- New UI
- New special places
- Improved gathering
- Controller support

With this update, previous save games won't work.
We would really appreciate any feedback on the newer version of Zombie Watch.

ZW dev team

-  Twitter
-  Facebook 
-  Discord 

Thanks,
 ZW Dev Team

notes.title: Gardening, Hireable NPC-s and Much more! - Version 0.5.1
notes.content:

Hello,

this big update brings a lot of new features and items to Zombie Watch. A lot of you have been asking for a new movement type for the character and we have delivered. This update brings you a new option of controlling your character and we have a feeling you will like it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31785142/24d614ecf09111319b1369b96e584a44a4e23392.png

notes.title: Bandits, performance, quality of life changes - Version 0.4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31785142/68b3e0a30408055691f7a3f41a0eb9ee3c8ba2fa.gif

Hello,

This bigger update brings a lot of changes, improvements, and features to Zombie Watch and just at the right time for the Winter Sale!

We focused on game optimization and made a lot of changes which improved loading time and overall memory consumption significantly. At the same time, we fixed several collision issues, a bug where the glass was causing damage to the player, the rain sound, and a few other bugs which are all listed below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31785142/16363a713cb7ac5d53490f2e4d8c8799fdd9eace.png

Now to the fun stuff - we added a lot of new things to the world of Zombie Watch! The most exciting new feature is Bandit Camps and locations with Bandit AIs! These are new special places designed especially for NPCs where they will attack you and you will need to fight for their loot. You can find Bandit Camps on the map marked as skeleton heads! They are designed as safe places for survivors and these AIs will not give up easily, you will get attacked for trespassing. We will be adding more of similar camps in the next updates.

Another exciting feature is the 5 newly designed buildings, a lot of newly added special places and a new small town to explore! The 5 new buildings include 2 new stores, a huge traditional villa, and 2 big residential brick houses all with new furniture, interior, and exterior. Other cool new special places include the plane crash location, the previously explained Bandit Camps and a few new rock formations. You can find a bunch of loot inside these new areas and this is not the end, we will be adding more new locations in the next updates! All of these are marked on the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31785142/67ea6c6f3bf67fadad1498b53488975c590feb53.png

We added 5 new searchable boxes and a backpack to the newer special places, which we will be adding across the world of Zombie Watch in the next few updates as well. The loot will be more specified in the next updates and not random. We have a few cool new features in mind and these boxes will come in handy with what we have planned.

You can now change names for all of your buildings and fast travel to all of your tents across the world of Zombie Watch which will save you a lot of time once you set up your tents where you want them. Naming them will come in handy.

Add-ons:
- You can now change the name of your buildings
- you can now fast travel to tents
- added Banit Locations
- added Bandit AIs
- added new locations

  Fixes:  
- decreased bear DPS
- fixed a bug where the glass was causing damage
- fixed rain sound
- decreased energy consumption by half and increased regeneration rate (sprint)
- fixed an issue causing arrows to miss animals
- fixed several collision issues
- improved loading time and ram consumption overall
- fixed a bug where crafting multiple items would stop at 1 less then queued
- fixed a bug changing input keys  

In the end, we will like to thank all of you amazing players of Zombie Watch for a great year and we wish you all Happy Holidays and all the best in the upcoming year 2020!

ZW dev team

-  Twitter
-  Facebook 
-  Discord 

Thanks,
 ZW Dev Team

This bigger update brings a lot of new things and we are also all set for the Halloween event! Zombies in the world of Zombie Watch are now wearing pumpkin heads and the game is made more fun with a Halloween theme song. What can be scarier than zombies on Halloween, right? Also, you can now bake a pumpkin pie!

More importantly, we completed 2 new biomes, the tundra area with pine trees and the snowy winter area! They are both filled with resources like wood, stones, sticks, fiber, different ore and have a lot of special places to explore where you can find a lot of loot. You can fast travel to the winter area or choose a more scenic route and travel by foot or horse to make sure you will not miss the tundra area which divides the main world from the winter area.

notes.title: Wildlak - Company Rebranding
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/0073833ff42f787b9ea1e1aa933742d8c58d910e.png

We are proud to announce that we have started a rebranding process for our company name to Wildlak and here is the reason why. We have grown out of our initial mission and our company has taken a turn for new goals. At Nebula X Games we have started as an indie mobile game developer and have since moved on to developing a PC game, which was our hidden dream all along. We are grateful for the experiences and success the mobile games and apps gave brought but we feel it is time for new victories. It is time to reach for our dreams. To go wild like Wildlak.

Wildlak Mission:
Our mission is to bring an amazing gaming experience to the players. We are gamers ourselves and we are creating a game we love to play ourselves. Our focus and drive are based on the needs of a player, which is why we respect every opinion and feedback. 

We assure you this rebranding process is not going to disturb our game development process, not even the slightest. You can find our new company page at https://www.wildlak.com while the Zombie Watch Official Page will stay live as it is for now, but will change to a new domain in the near future.

notes.title: Electricity, Power Cables and Storage
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/acd7f740c7b5c1f0d2a7c798fe02d4e14a01d1be.gif

Hello!

We have been working on some cool features in Zombie Watch , which all derive from – electricity! It opens up a whole new way of automatization in the game and gives you multiple options for doing things high tech, which we already stated we are doing.

We added electricity, power cables, electronic traps, generators, lights and power poles. All of the electronic equipment will need to be connected with power cables and it will have its own Power Management process. For example, 1 light will take 3- power points, while 1 small generator will provide 10+. The generators will work on fuel and every item will have its own energy usage. If there is no more energy or the cables get disconnected, everything connected will shut down. You will be able to craft sensors, which will warn you when the zombies are attacking your base, you will also be able to have electronic gates and so on.

This first gif shows you a little bit of the Power Management process.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/41cc0d27e6c7c6bb7292f2f65248185c32433ca1.png

notes.title: The Open World of Zombie Watch
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/d1eda505a38c55d80e523dc3a60ffe0394fe6cf5.png

Hello!

Here is the first official map of Zombie Watch! As we previously stated, there are 3 different biomes forest, desert, and snow, with extra special places, including the swamp.

There is a main road connecting every biome with a bunch of smaller roads that are either shortcuts in between the towns or roads to more secluded places, like dirt roads leading through the swamp. There are rivers flowing into the sea which surrounds the whole island. The bigger towns are placed in close vicinity to rivers, are abandoned and infested with zombies. There are a few newer communities made out of recycled materials where the survivals have made their shelters and secure places to function.

The desert and snow biomes will have its own special resources and will be very rewarding to explore.

Beside the map, we are currently working on polishing the AIs, zombies, and animals.

notes.title: UI updates
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/e6a28077784ecd48ce4a0833abae3f7998224bf5.png

Hello,

it is time for another update. The Zombie Watch User Interface has been  redesigned for a better experience. We want to make this game the best it can be and use the Interface without having to read the instructions beforehand. We want it to be simple and enjoyable.  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/9a17da41c274ae92a2e79f205e3b0da285c1b3e9.png

Thus, here are the changes:
First of all, we combined the Character Screen and the Inventory to give it more orderliness. Because you will be using this window the most, this was an easy choice. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/b7ba07a161f59d3cb693b3b8b4de274d06c28e19.png

We moved Food and Water indicators to the main window where it is visible all the time. You can follow the changing value of your energy levels all the time to make sure to fill up when necessary. You can follow the value of your energy levels, the type of weapon you have equipped and the number of ammo you have left.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/412cd73ccf549c4300ecb6e61ced8abc5228ffc5.png

The Minimap will feature the close vicinity of the character, the day and time in the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/6064133955d23d6b72e7f258ac7e64fc08abad83.png

The Action Bar will be used for food, drinks, medical kits and skills.
Collecting resources has been changed in a way that you collect resources directly to the Inventory. So when you hit the tree with an axe, you collect wood. The same goes for collecting stones and other metals. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/c4726873db20082c4466ea2890d8125e393acc8b.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/1380a7fa119d5a4e103cc82b47a5509fefe189fc.png
Player Crafting Menu is divided into Harvest, Consumable and Ammo Tabs. For crafting these basic items, such as Primitive Axe, you don’t need a Crafting Station. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/7e23cc9aa8c3888b8a3c8c242856406299d6e80a.png
The Build Menu is divided into Basic, Advanced and Defensive buildings. An example of a basic buildable item is a Campfire.

Notification UI
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/2a6c1da9f136978dad7829806d86a448983f6198.png

notes.title: Male - Female Character, Enviroment Physics and Delay Announcement
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/56a4e15fe1e7371304b9f8f29fd16bf63c39b0ca.png

Hello,

this month we made a choice and added a female character, which was our plan for the future development anyways but we went ahead and made the change now. Because of this we also needed to replace the male model since our previous character and the female version were too different. We are happy with our choice and it will not affect the overall feel of the game or its design. The armours and clothing will basically stay the same but now we have an option to add various clothing elements down to the underwear. This is a great addition to the scavenging part and being able to customize your characters clothing per your taste. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/3681c9eea0c3ddbf754e81ed65b6ae94854863f4.gif

The other feature we are loving at the moment is the additional physics in the environment. Some objects in the game will be physics based and will react on the movement and environment, as you can see on the gif. The flowers and herbs are a bit enlarged in this case because we wanted to point out the physics but they will be useful in making medicine and healing potions. 

Delay Announcement

Since we are an indie developing team, we are very limited as far as the game developing process is concerned. We have day jobs and we are mostly working on evenings and weekends, basically in all of our spare time. This is our hobby and our passion so there are no complaints, but we do need to make a delay for the game release. We want to make sure to create the best game that it is in our abilities and we do not want to rush things and make quick fixes. This is why we are changing the release date to next year. We will still make regular monthly updates and keep you in the loop of whats happening in the world of Zombie Watch. 

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Build a Home For Survivors!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/cad69f7b13082dcb002ca2ea303c416b65781e09.png

Hello,

There is an abandoned school in Zombie Watch, filled with zombies. Outside of the school, there is a gated playground, where you can build. Isn't this place awesome?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/eba70afb4b57735db81bbe5c86a0308d59648398.png

After you find this place and are equipped enough, you can take a shot at killing the zombies. It can be a death trap if you are not careful, but it has amazing potential. It is a huge space just waiting for a new community.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/b0ae24ffa75d68b3177f562c98a44cd64b765f7b.png

Once you wipe out all of the zombies and eliminate all the dangers, you can convert it into a big shelter for the survivors. It will become a community of people who work for you in exchange for basic survival items, such as food and water. You will also need to take care of the defense, hire mercenaries shopkeeps and more.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/60183ecb1b665b68fa218871bf55b7852967d0c5.png

This is still work in progress and will change during development.
We will post our scheduled updates once a month from now on because we are currently focusing on coop.

notes.title: Talent Points & Specializations
notes.content:
Hello,

this update is based on the Talent Points & Specializations, the 3 specializations for the main character of Zombie Watch, which are a Defensive, Offensive, and Support. The use of these abilities will make fights more interesting and will be very helpful, especially when playing coop. Special skills will be a major help in your survival!

Every specialization will have different abilities, but they won't be limited to a single character. You will be able to choose from every single specialization. For example, the offensive spec will have a flamethrower, the defensive spec will have a shield and the support class will have the ability to heal with special chemicals.

notes.title: Biomes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/232da52e67eafe52d7c5117af840fde55cf9e596.gif

Hi everyone,

lately, we have been focusing mainly on different biomes for the Zombie Watch world. 

The upper part of the ZW map is a cold and harsh mountain climate with low temperatures, snow, and ice. This place contains most of the ore and metal. The character will be cold here so you will need a better and warmer equipment to explore it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/bf5e7ab5e5fc54d580f2787543ed874e898d6a83.gif

The center part is the most suitable environment for survival. It offers most of the beneficial resources, like wood, stones, and wildlife. This is also the best place to build your base.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31785142/f976ebfd0f5f40e3ab60238b62272095bd8dd927.gif

On the lower end of the map, the environment will gradually turn into a tropical climate with sandy beaches and palm trees. Here you can find a bunch of rare resources.
